name: Loki
thought: I feel bigger! I'm level 11 now.

thoughts: i wonder if the winter moths are hiding near the fountain.
everything feels quiet and peaceful under the moonlight.
the teal scarf really keeps me warm tonight.
i should try to learn a new song on the piano soon.
it is almost christmas, i need to prepare some decorations.
my studio smells like ink and peppermint tea.
i hope the gallery visitors enjoyed the new prints.
being a cat is the best way to live.
